Subject: Compact demo marathon — one-hour windows for multiple prospects

Hi all,

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood Inference. We're running a short "demo marathon" next week to give each prospect a tightly scoped one-hour walk-through focused on inference performance, routing, and cost controls. The goal is to keep each session concise (45 min demo + 15 min Q&A) so engineering teams can jump in/out without scheduling conflicts.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Wed 18 May: 09:00–10:00
- Wed 18 May: 11:00–12:00
- Wed 18 May: 14:00–15:00
- Thu 19 May: 08:00–09:00

Action items — please reply with your preferred window: 
- Acme (Sara): pick one or two options
- Northwind (Mike): pick one option
- BrightBridge: pick one option

I've attached a short-demo-agenda.pdf with the outline and a tiny pre-demo checklist (network, sample prompt, expected throughput). If you have any hard constraints on timezones or attendees (SRE only, product + infra, exec overview), mention those and we'll try to match.

If multiple folks pick the same window we'll do a quick shuffle to accommodate as many as possible; happy to split a block into two parallel rooms if demand is high.

Thanks — looking forward to locking times.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
